units.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for Cpp reads and writes PDF documents, extracts text, and converts pages to image formats such as PNG. It builds documents from scratch, supporting text, tables, vector graphics, watermarks, annotations, AcroForm fields, and bookmarks. It encrypts and decrypts files using AESx256 and handles password-protected documents. It reads document metadata and information such as title, author, and keywords, and writes updated values back to the file.

It opens existing PDF files with Aspose.Pdf.Document, supports password-protected files by passing a user or owner password to the constructor, and reports encryption status via IsEncrypted(); it also allows byte-verbatim round-trips or incremental /Info updates that preserve original bytes.

It extracts text using Aspose.Pdf.Text::TextAbsorber to walk a whole document or a single page, and provides typed access to document information such as title, author, subject, keywords, creator, producer, and dates through Aspose.Pdf.DocumentInfo, plus arbitrary custom entries via Add/Remove/ClearCustomData.

It renders pages to raster images using Aspose.Pdf.Devices::PngDevice, JpegDevice, and BmpDevice for single-page output, and TiffDevice for single-page or multi-page ranges with median-cut palette quantisation or caller-supplied palette conversion.

It encrypts documents using Document::Encrypt with user and owner passwords, granular Aspose.Pdf.Permissions flags, and algorithms including RC4-40, RC4-128, AES-128, and AES-256, and signs documents with Aspose.Pdf.Facades::PdfFileSignature to add detached PKCS#7 signatures.

It builds documents from scratch using positioned text via Aspose.Pdf.Text::TextBuilder and TextFragment, tabular layout with Aspose.Pdf.Table (column widths, borders, background colours, and spanning cells), vector shapes via Aspose.Pdf.Drawing::Graph, and interactive AcroForm fields through Aspose.Pdf.Forms.
It supports the Standard-14 fonts without an embedded /FontFile, painting correctly via system fonts and falling back to bundled substitutes so glyphs render even in fontless environments.

It provides the classic Aspose.Pdf.Facades API for legacy workflows, including PdfConverter for rasterisation, PdfExtractor for text extraction with page ranges, PdfFileSecurity for encryption and password changes, PdfFileSignature for signing, PdfBookmarkEditor for bookmarks, PdfFileEditor for concatenation and splitting, and PdfFileStamp for headers, footers, and page numbers.
This example opens a PDF document, prints the page count, extracts all text, and renders the first page as a PNG image at 150 DPI.
The following workflows demonstrate opening encrypted files, reading and updating document metadata, and applying AESx256 encryption.
Open a password-protected PDF and check encryption status.
Read and update document metadata, then save changes.
Apply AESx256 encryption with user and owner passwords.
Include the main header to access the library.

Aspose.PDF FOSS for Cpp exposes the Aspose.Pdf.Document class as its primary entry point, which provides access to pages, metadata, forms, and annotations. Supporting classes such as Aspose.Pdf.DocumentInfo and Aspose.Pdf.LoadOptions enable metadata inspection and document loading configuration.

The Aspose.Pdf.Document class loads PDF files from a path, supports password-protected documents, and exposes collections for pages, outlines, annotations, and embedded files, along with methods to encrypt, decrypt, and save the document.

The Aspose.Pdf.Text namespace provides text extraction via Aspose.Pdf.Text.TextAbsorber and Aspose.Pdf.Text.TextFragmentAbsorber, which visit a document and expose extracted text content and fragment details.

The Aspose.Pdf.Devices namespace offers rendering devices such as Aspose.Pdf.Devices.PageDevice, with concrete implementations like PngDevice and TiffDevice, and resolution control via Aspose.Pdf.Devices.Resolution to set horizontal and vertical DPI.
The Aspose.Pdf.CryptoAlgorithm class enumerates supported encryption algorithms including AESx256, and works with the Aspose.Pdf.Permissions flags to control document access and modification rights.

The Aspose.Pdf.Annotations namespace provides annotation support through Aspose.Pdf.Annotations.Annotation and Aspose.Pdf.Annotations.AnnotationCollection, enabling addition, enumeration, and manipulation of annotation objects on pages.
The Aspose.Pdf.Forms namespace exposes form handling via Aspose.Pdf.Forms.FormType and Aspose.Pdf.Forms.TextBoxField, supporting form field creation, addition to pages, and flattening.
The Aspose.Pdf.Facades namespace provides high-level utilities including Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfConverter for rasterizing PDFs and Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor for scoped text extraction.
The Aspose.Pdf.Table namespace offers table support via Aspose.Pdf.Table, Aspose.Pdf.Row, and Aspose.Pdf.Cell, enabling structured content with column widths, borders, and cell styling.
The Aspose.Pdf.Drawing namespace provides vector drawing primitives such as Aspose.Pdf.Drawing.Graph, Aspose.Pdf.Drawing.Rectangle, and Aspose.Pdf.Drawing.Circle for embedding graphics in PDFs.

The Aspose.Pdf.OutlineCollection class manages document outlines and works with Aspose.Pdf.OutlineItemCollection and Aspose.Pdf.NamedDestinationCollection to define navigable bookmarks and destinations.
The Aspose.Pdf.Metadata namespace provides XMP metadata access through Aspose.Pdf.XmpValue, enabling programmatic reading and writing of document metadata properties.

The Aspose.Pdf.PageCollection class manages document pages via a 1-based indexer, supporting addition, insertion, deletion, and counting of pages, and works with Aspose.Pdf.Page and Aspose.Pdf.PageLabelCollection.
It adds full support for every Facades method (including PdfFileEditor and PdfFileStamp), complete XMP type-checking, and broader format coverage beyond this FOSS edition's v1 scope.

TextBoxField class provides methods to manage AddBarcode, ForceCombs, MaxLen, Multiline, Scrollable, SpellCheck, TextVerticalAlignment, and Value properties.
Aspose.Pdf.Forms.XFA class provides access to XFA field names and the XFA data stream.
Aspose.Pdf.GraphInfo class holds the color, fill color, line width, dash array, dash phase, rotation angle, and scaling information for vector graphics.
Aspose.Pdf.HorizontalAlignment enum lists the Center, FullJustify, Justify, Left, None, and Right horizontal alignment options.
Aspose.Pdf.Hyperlink class represents a hyperlink object.
Aspose.Pdf.IIndexBitmapConverter interface provides methods to convert indexed bitmaps to 1-bpp, 4-bpp, and 8-bpp images.
Aspose.Pdf.LoadOptions class provides options for loading PDF documents, including disabling font license verifications.
Aspose.Pdf.MarginInfo class holds the left, right, top, and bottom margin values.
Aspose.Pdf.Metadata class provides methods to add, remove, and query document metadata, including namespace prefix management.
Aspose.Pdf.NamedDestinationCollection class provides methods to add, remove, and enumerate named destinations.
Aspose.Pdf.NumberingStyle enum lists the LettersLowercase, LettersUppercase, None, NumeralsArabic, NumeralsRomanLowercase, and NumeralsRomanUppercase numbering styles.
Aspose.Pdf.OutlineCollection class represents the collection of document outlines.
Aspose.Pdf.OutlineItemCollection class provides methods to manage outline items, including action, destination, bold, italic, level, and next item properties.
Aspose.Pdf.Outlines class provides methods to add, remove, and enumerate outline items.
Aspose.Pdf.Page class provides methods to add images, annotations, and artifacts, and to access page boxes such as MediaBox, CropBox, ArtBox, and BleedBox.
Aspose.Pdf.PageCollection class provides methods to add, insert, and delete pages.
Aspose.Pdf.PageCoordinateType enum lists the CropBox and MediaBox coordinate types.
Aspose.Pdf.PageLabel class provides methods to set the numbering style, prefix, and starting value for page labels.
Aspose.Pdf.PageLabelCollection class provides methods to get page labels, retrieve pages for a label, and update or remove labels.
Aspose.Pdf.PageSize class provides methods to access standard page sizes such as A0 through A6 and B5.
Aspose.Pdf.Paragraphs class provides methods to add, insert, remove, and clear paragraphs.
Aspose.Pdf.PasswordType enum lists the Inaccessible, None, Owner, and User password types.
Aspose.Pdf.PdfFormat enum lists the PDF/A and PDF/E format versions such as PDF_A_1A, PDF_A_1B, PDF_A_2A, PDF_A_2B, PDF_A_2U, PDF_A_3A, PDF_A_3B, PDF_A_3U, PDF_A_4, PDF_A_4E, PDF_A_4F, and PDF_E_1.

Aspose.Pdf.Permissions enum lists the document permission flags such as AssembleDocument, ExtractContent, ExtractContentWithDisabilities, FillForm, ModifyContent, ModifyTextAnnotations, PrintDocument, and PrintingQuality.
Aspose.Pdf.Point class provides methods to calculate distance, access X and Y coordinates, and check triviality.
Aspose.Pdf.Rectangle class provides methods to check containment of points and lines, compute center, height, and perform intersection.
Aspose.Pdf.RenderingOptions class provides options for rendering, including font analysis, barcode optimization, font conversion, default font name, cache size, and interpolation quality.
Aspose.Pdf.Resources class provides access to images and resources.
Aspose.Pdf.Rotation enum lists the None, on90, on180, and on270 rotation values.
Aspose.Pdf.Row class provides methods to set background color, border, cells, default cell properties, fixed row height, and new page behavior.
Aspose.Pdf.Rows class provides methods to add, count, index, remove, and remove ranges of rows.
Aspose.Pdf.SvgLoadOptions class provides options for loading SVG, including adjusting page size.
Aspose.Pdf.Table class provides methods to set alignment, background color, border, column widths, and default cell properties.
Aspose.Pdf.Text.Encoding class provides methods to encode and decode text, including BigEndianUnicode, code page, and string conversion.
Aspose.Pdf.Text.Font class provides methods to access base font, font name, and embedding or subset status.
Aspose.Pdf.Text.FontRepository class provides methods to find and open fonts.
Aspose.Pdf.Text.Position class provides methods to set X and Y indentation for text.
Aspose.Pdf.Text.TextAbsorber class provides methods to visit pages, extract text, check for errors, and access the extracted text.
Aspose.Pdf.Text.TextBuilder class provides methods to append text and paragraphs to a page.
Aspose.Pdf.Text.TextFragment class provides methods to set position, rectangle, text, text state, and constructor.
Aspose.Pdf.Text.TextFragmentAbsorber class provides methods to visit pages and access text fragments.
TextFragmentCollection class holds a collection of text fragments and provides a Count method to get the number of items.
TextFragmentState class provides state settings for text fragments and includes a constructor to initialize a new instance.

TextParagraph class represents a paragraph of text and provides methods such as AppendLine, FirstLineIndent, HorizontalAlignment, Margin, Position, Rectangle, SubsequentLinesIndent, and VerticalAlignment to configure its content and layout.

TextState class defines text appearance settings and provides methods such as BackgroundColor, CharacterSpacing, Font, FontSize, ForegroundColor, HorizontalAlignment, HorizontalScaling, and Invisible to control formatting.
VerticalAlignment enum lists the Bottom, Center, None, and Top vertical alignment options.
WatermarkArtifact class represents a watermark artifact that can be added to a PDF page.
XImage class represents an image in a PDF document and provides methods such as ContainsTransparency, GetRawImageData, Height, ImageMask, Name, and Width to access its properties.
XImageCollection class manages a collection of XImage objects and provides methods such as Add, Clear, Contains, Count, Delete, GetImageName, Names, and Remove to manipulate the collection.

XmpValue class represents an XMP value and provides methods such as IsArray, IsDateTime, IsDouble, IsField, IsInteger, IsNamedValue, IsNamedValues, and IsRaw to query its type; IsDateTime, IsField, IsNamedValue, IsNamedValues, IsRaw, and IsStructure always return false.
